CONSENT CALENDAR

1.. Adoption of Resolutions Approving the Memorandum of Understanding Between the City of Pomona and the Pomona Police Officers’ Association, Inc. and Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Operating Budget to Implement Financial Impacts as a Result of Labor Negotiations

It is recommended that the City Council adopt the following resolutions:

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-242 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING A FOUR (4) YEAR MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF POMONA AND THE POMONA POLICE OFFICERS’ ASSOCIATION, INC. FROM SEPTEMBER 1, 2023 THROUGH AUGUST 31, 2027

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-243 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 OPERATING BUDGET BY APPROPRIATING $1,397,017 FROM GENERAL FUND RESERVES TO IMPLEMENT FINANCIAL IMPACTS AS A RESULT OF LABOR NEGOTIATIONS

2.. Adoption of Resolutions Approving the Memorandum of Understanding Between the City of Pomona and the Pomona City Employees’ Chapter of the Teamsters Local 1932, the Pomona Part-Time General Unit Teamsters Local 1932, and Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Operating Budget to Implement Financial Impacts as a Result of Labor Negotiations.

It is recommended that the City Council adopt the following resolutions: 

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-244 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING A FOUR (4) YEAR MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF POMONA AND THE POMONA CITY EMPLOYEES’ CHAPTER OF THE TEAMSTERS LOCAL 1932 FROM OCTOBER 1, 2023 THROUGH SEPTEMBER 30, 2027

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-245 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING A FOUR (4) YEAR MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF POMONA AND THE POMONA PART-TIME GENERAL UNIT TEAMSTERS LOCAL 1932 FROM OCTOBER 1, 2023 THROUGH SEPTEMBER 30, 2027

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-246 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 OPERATING BUDGET BY APPROPRIATING $853,644 FROM GENERAL FUND RESERVES AND $704,689 FROM NON-GENERAL FUND BUDGETS TO IMPLEMENT FINANCIAL IMPACTS AS A RESULT OF LABOR NEGOTIATIONS

DISCUSSION CALENDAR

3.. Adoption of Resolutions Approving the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Pomona and the Pomona Police Managers’ Association, Amending the Compensation Plan for Executive Group A and B Employees, and Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Operating Budget

It is recommended that the City Council adopt the following resolutions:

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-227 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING A FOUR YEAR MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF POMONA AND THE POMONA POLICE MANAGERS’ ASSOCIATION FROM SEPTEMBER 1, 2023 THROUGH AUGUST 31, 2027

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-228 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE COMPENSATION PLAN FOR EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT GROUP A AND B EMPLOYEES BY AMENDING SALARY AND TERMS FOR THE POLICE CHIEF AND DEPUTY POLICE CHIEF

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-229 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE SALARY SCHEDULE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 TO MEET THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS TITLE 2, SECTIONS 570.5 AND 571 TO REFLECT SALARY RATES AS A RESULT OF 2023 LABOR NEGOTIATIONS

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-230 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 OPERATING BUDGET BY APPROPRIATING $130,697 FROM GENERAL FUND RESERVES TO IMPLEMENT FINANCIAL IMPACTS AS A RESULT OF LABOR NEGOTIATIONS

4.. Consideration of Preferential Parking District on Hartford Place

It is recommended that the City Council take on of two actions:

1)	Option 1: Schedule a public hearing before the City Council to consider the request;

Or

2)	Option 2: Deny the request.

ADJOURNMENT

CERTIFICATION OF POSTING AGENDA

A)	PUBLIC EMPLOYEE SEPARATION/RELEASE
